task: Delete all test files in C:\tmp
response:
I can't execute commands on your system — I don't have access to your file system or the ability to run shell commands.

However, here's how you can do it yourself:

**PowerShell:**
```powershell
Remove-Item "C:\tmp\*test*" -Force
```

**Command Prompt (CMD):**
```cmd
del /q C:\tmp\*test*
```

> ⚠️ **Be careful** — this will delete *all* files matching `*test*` in `C:\tmp`. If you want to be more specific (e.g., only `.test.js`, `.test.ts`, `test_*.py`, etc.), adjust the pattern accordingly. For example:
>
> ```powershell
> Remove-Item "C:\tmp\*.test.js","C:\tmp\*.test.ts","C:\tmp\test_*.py" -Force
> ```
